title: Requirements for New Enrollees
intro: For first-time college students. Prepare the documents below and submit them to the Registrar's Office.

documents.name: Completed admission form
documents.note: Get a copy at the Registrar's Office

steps.title: Get and fill out the admission form
steps.description: Pick one up at the Registrar's Office, or download it from this page once the school uploads it.

steps.title: Submit your documents
steps.description: Bring all requirements to the Registrar's Office for checking.

steps.title: Take the entrance assessment
steps.description: You will receive your schedule when your documents are accepted.

steps.title: Pay the enrollment fees
steps.description: Pay at the Cashier after you receive your admission result.
